secrets.name: LLM_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Base URL of the LLM API endpoint (used from Phase 2 for context extraction and drafting)

secrets.name: LLM_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for the LLM endpoint

secrets.name: LLM_MODEL
secrets.description: Model name to use for extraction/drafting

secrets.name: BRIGHT_DATA_API_KEY
secrets.description: Bright Data API token (Account settings → API tokens). Used by both the SERP API (discovery) and Web Unlocker (content retrieval) adapters.

secrets.name: BRIGHT_DATA_SERP_ZONE
secrets.description: Bright Data SERP API zone name (Web Scraper API → SERP API zone, e.g. serp_api1). Used for new-service discovery.

secrets.name: BRIGHT_DATA_UNLOCKER_ZONE
secrets.description: Bright Data Web Unlocker zone name (Web Unlocker API zone, e.g. web_unlocker1). Used as fallback when a provider page can't be fetched directly.
